title: eval-harness: improve per-prompt regression CI metrics and hooks
author: Sofia Ramirez
description:
Motivation: our per-prompt regression checks have been producing noisy signals for low-volume prompt sets and failing to upload consolidated metrics to the central metrics pipeline. This PR improves the eval-harness CI hooks to 1) aggregate per-prompt metrics into a stable summary payload, 2) add smoothing logic to reduce false positive regression alerts for low-sample prompts, and 3) add a resilient metrics upload step with retry/backoff and dry-run support.

What this change does: checklist:
- [x] Add per-prompt aggregation utility (percentiles, sample counts, variance) and export in standardized schema
- [x] Introduce low-sample smoothing: require minimum sample threshold or apply Bayesian shrinkage to reduce noise
- [x] Add metrics uploader with retry/backoff, idempotency via run_id, and fallbacks to artifact upload on pipeline outage
- [x] Wire updated checks into CI job eval-harness/per-prompt-metrics and add a fast-path for PRs that touch only docs/examples
- [x] Add unit and integration tests for the new aggregation logic and uploader

Notes: The description and tests are intentionally conservative to avoid changing alerting thresholds. This is an infrastructure improvement that should make future quality gating less noisy and more actionable. Related: ENG-3281 tracks the follow-up work to expose the aggregated metrics in the rollout dashboard. The PR touches both the test harness and CI job definitions; it does not change production serving code.

Usage: the new uploader is enabled by default in CI; developers can run eval-harness/tools/aggregate_metrics.py locally with the --dry-run flag to validate payloads before opening a PR. The README includes examples of the new schema and the minimum sample heuristics.

release_notes:
Improvements to eval-harness CI for per-prompt regression checks:
- Aggregate per-prompt metrics into stable summary payloads
- Add low-sample smoothing to reduce false positives
- Resilient metrics uploader with retries and artifact fallback
- CI job updates to wire new gating without changing production serving code
notes: Follow-ups: expose aggregated metrics in rollout dashboard (ENG-3281); evaluate whether smoothing thresholds should be per-model in a later change (ENG-3300).
how_to_revert: Revert is safe: revert the single merge commit. If metrics uploader causes issues, set EVAL_METRICS_UPLOAD=0 in CI until rollback applies.
